problem: Which set is equivalent to $A={x\in R:{x}^{2}+1=0}?$
worked_solution:
The elements of the given set are the real numbers that satisfy the equation ${x}^{2}+1=0.$ 

So, we first need to solve our equation for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+1 & =0 \\ {x}^{2} & =-1 \\ x & =\pm \sqrt{-1} \\ x & =\pm \text{i}\end{aligned}
$$

However, since $x\in R$ and $\pm \text{i}\notin R,$ we conclude that the set $A$ contains no elements. Hence, $A=∅.$
